ConnectionStrings._comment: Override per-environment in appsettings.{Environment}.json. Production should use environment variables or secrets manager — NOT hardcode here.

JwtSettings._comment: Override Jwt:Secret in appsettings.{Environment}.json or via env var Jwt__Secret. MUST be at least 32 chars.

StorageSettings._comment: See appsettings.Development.json for Local provider config and appsettings.Production.json for Supabase provider config.
